purpose: Four new transparent hand-painted metal-stock image assets requested for jade-market-prototype

assets.name: 足金24K
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: an individual transparent PNG inventory/shop material icon for the existing Chinese jade jewelry management game.
Input images: image 1 is ONLY a reference for the CURRENT GAME UI palette, scale, quiet mood and pictured material categories; image 2 is ONLY a reference for the hand-painted jewelry material rendering. Do not redraw either image or its UI.
Primary request: create ONE refined small metal ingot icon that looks native to that exact game art direction.
Subject: ONE compact rectangular cast precious-metal bar with softly rounded corners, slightly tapered sides, low profile, broad top face and clearly visible front and right thickness. The long axis runs gently from lower left to upper right, at about 12 degrees. Three-quarter view from above at about 35 degrees. This is raw jewelry fabrication stock, with an understated shallow stamped hallmark centered on its top face.
Style/medium: restrained 2D hand-painted gouache/watercolor game item illustration, softly faceted painted planes, very fine paper-like pigment grain contained ONLY within the object, delicate gray-brown contour, smooth readable silhouette, consistent with the reference gemstones and hand-painted gold/silver jewelry. Polished enough to read as metal but still painterly. Low saturation, low-to-medium contrast.
Composition: square canvas; one entire isolated bar centered at the exact center with generous transparent padding, occupying approximately 74% of canvas width and 42% height. Same icon framing, perspective and proportions across the material set. No cropping.
Lighting: broad soft light from upper left; one restrained broad highlight on top, gentle shadows on the side faces, no cast shadow outside the object.
Background: genuine alpha transparency, completely transparent around the object.
Constraints: ONLY the bar and its tiny understated engraved hallmark. No frame, no card, no hands, no props, no extra bars, no gemstones, no glitter, no glow, no scenic background, no checkerboard drawn into the image, no watermark, no labels outside the object. Avoid photorealism, glossy 3D/PBR rendering, dramatic reflections, shiny chrome, heavy cartoon outline, saturated orange gold. Preserve clean alpha edges, no colored halos.
Material and color: pure 24K gold, warm muted ochre-gold with honey midtones and subdued pale yellow highlights, darker bronze-gold on side faces.
Text (verbatim): "24K", tiny shallow engraved stamp in plain simple lettering on the top face. No other text.
